basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at the HKUST NLP Group, supervised by Prof. Junxian He. Graduated from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (B.Eng., 2024). Researching natural language processing, LLM reasoning, reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness.

work.summary: Research intern (June 2024 - September 2024). Advised by Zifei Shan.
Research intern (June 2023 - December 2023). Advised by Prof. Yu Cheng.
